records.text: Candace Owens cites an article reporting that Arizona Governor Jan Brewer appointed Tyler Bowyer as the newest student regent on the Arizona Board of Regents.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: It says governor appoints the new student regent. And within the article, it tells us that that's what happened. Arizona State University student Tyler (Tyler Bowyer) was appointed as the newest student regent on the Arizona Board of Regents by Governor Jan Brewer last year.

verification.notes: A contemporaneous April 2011 Daily Wildcat article states that Arizona State University student Tyler Bowyer was appointed the newest student regent by Governor Jan Brewer and would begin a two-year term in July.

sources.title: Daily Wildcat - Governor appoints new student regent
sources.relevance: Directly confirms Bowyer's appointment by Governor Jan Brewer.

records.text: Unlike the typical university committee recommendation process, Tyler Bowyer applied directly through the Arizona governor's office for the student-regent position.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Last month, a new student regent is selected every year, rotating between the three state universities. Though regents are typically selected from recommendations made by a selection committee at the university, Bowyer applied directly through the governor's office.

verification.notes: The contemporaneous article states student regents were typically selected from university committee recommendations but Bowyer applied directly through Governor Brewer's office. Bowyer is quoted explaining he applied for multiple boards-and-commissions positions.
